about_the_game:
EmyLiveShow: Dungeon & Mistresses Tale is a hentai visual novel with dice rolling mechanics. Customize your character and become a game master who has a party of four very naughty players!

They are trying to escape your dungeon and remember why they got there in the first place. What will you give them on this journey? A tight plot with subtle clues or a bunch of random encounters? Dangerous enemies or sexy NPCs to romance? The choice is yours: be the lawful or chaotic master!

EmyLiveShow: Dungeon & Mistresses Tale features:

  • Customizable main character. Choose your gender and appearance at the start of the game, then build your personality through choices and opinions until the end.

  • Hot scenes for every taste. Enjoy fully animated hentai CGs with different kinks and characters!

  • Two parallel storylines. Emy, Nia, Uma and Six immerse themselves in the role play and are ready to discuss the plot in the breaks!

  • Dice rolls and item system. Random outcomes make each playthrough unique, and items can be used to control the situation.Old favorites from previous D&M Tales. And many new characters with their own dungeon stories!
